lede: The San Miguel County BOCC holds public hearings Wednesday on three Land Use Code amendments — including changes to how 'Qualified Owner' is defined in the deed-restriction code, a wildfire areas update, and a nonconforming lots hearing — all moving toward formal votes, so this is a real window to weigh in. The Telluride Housing Authority Subcommittee also meets Wednesday on a deed-restricted homeowner's request to exceed improvement limits for a necessary roof replacement. Wrapping up the week, the Jazz Festival kicks off Friday alongside the KOTO Duck Race.

notable.stake: Public hearings on three Land Use Code changes, including deed-restriction and wildfire rules.
Vote on whether a deed-restricted homeowner can exceed capital improvement limits for a new roof.
Land Use Code definition changes being shaped — definitions determine what rules mean in practice.
Design review votes on three new multifamily projects in Mountain Village, including a conditional-use permit.
